meta.description: Automatic flow of inquiries from social networks for any business. No complex funnels, no daily manual grind.

hero.bullet2: Works even if marketing isn’t your thing

business.title: Who gets clients from this
business.card1_text: You need new people every day. The system finds contacts, opens the conversation, and helps get them to a call.
business.card2_text: Studios, courses, agencies, shops. Inquiries from social without expensive ads and without hiring a marketing department.
business.card3_text: Scale without chaos: more dialogues, less manual grind. One process — clear numbers at the end.

features.title: How it brings you clients
features.f1_text: Problem: unclear who to message first. Solution: the system gathers the right people on Facebook. Result: your contact list keeps growing.
features.f2_text: Problem: easy to look like spam and get ignored. Solution: careful first messages and comments on posts. Result: more replies and real chats.
features.f3_text: Problem: leads vanish in threads. Solution: clear stages and follow-ups like a good rep. Result: fewer lost deals, more revenue.
features.f4_text: Problem: no time to click every day. Solution: actions planned weeks ahead. Result: steady flow without daily babysitting.
features.f5_text: Problem: fresh profiles get blocked fast. Solution: soft, human-like activity. Result: lower risk, more stable runs.
features.f6_text: Problem: chats scattered across tabs. Solution: conversations inside one app. Result: faster replies, faster closes.

ai.title: AI features that drive clients
ai.body: The AI looks at the audience, picks words, and chats like a strong sales rep — without weekends or burnout.
ai.quote: “It writes so people answer — and more often reach the request stage.”

items.quote: In two weeks I got more qualified requests than in three months of paid ads. Money finally went to conversations, not clicks.
items.name: Alex Morozov

items.quote: I used to live in chats. Now part of the follow-up runs itself — I jump in where interest is already warm.
items.name: Maria Kovaleva

items.quote: I run it on a spare Mac and rarely touch settings. The lead stream runs in the background like a hire without payroll.
items.name: Michael Orlov

items.quote: I thought it was “for techies.” Took one evening. A month later — noticeably more calls and bookings.
items.name: Dmitry Sokolov

items.quote: Clear logic: who we touch, what we say, what counts as success. Reports show numbers, not decoration.
items.name: Elena Volkova

items.quote: Manual outreach used to eat the team. Scenarios now run on their own — people don’t go cold in the funnel.
items.name: Ilya Karpov

items.quote: We needed conversations with money behind them, not followers. In a month there were more real talks and payments.
items.name: Anna Svetlova

items.quote: Launched once — the system pushes people toward “how do I buy?” I only catch the hot ones.
items.name: Sergey Nikiforov

items.quote: We wanted cold social traffic with a request in mind. Here everything ties to a lead, not a pretty dashboard.
items.name: Olga Remez
